locale.name: Locale
locale.desc: Language and region for date formatting (e.g., en, fr, de, es). Use 'auto' to inherit from Obsidian.
locale.invalid: Unknown locale code. Use a code like en, fr or fr-CA, or leave empty to follow Obsidian.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Your change was not applied.

weekStart.name: Week starts on
weekStart.desc: First day of the week for calendar displays

enableDatePicker.name: Enable date picker
enableDatePicker.desc: Show calendar picker UI for date selection

enableNLP.name: Enable natural language parsing
enableNLP.desc: Parse date expressions like "tomorrow", "next Monday", "3 days ago"

nlpAutoDetect.name: Auto-detect language
nlpAutoDetect.desc: Automatically detect and parse date expressions. Supported: English, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Dutch.

nlpStrictMode.name: Parsing mode
nlpStrictMode.desc: Controls how aggressively the parser matches text

dailyNotes.description: Configure how daily note wikilinks are generated. These settings apply when using the "Link to daily note" or "Open daily note" actions.

aliasFormat.desc: Format preset for the display text (alias) in daily note wikilinks

createIfMissing.name: Create daily note if missing
createIfMissing.desc: Automatically create the daily note file when it doesn't exist (uses your Daily Notes template)

text.description: The format the "Insert as text" action starts from. Preset commands are unaffected — each one carries its own format.

defaultDateFormat.name: Default date format
defaultDateFormat.desc: The format selector opens on this preset, and updates it whenever you pick another one.

triggers.description: Type one of these sequences in a note to insert a date. Each trigger opens either the date picker or the inline suggestions, whichever its mode says.
triggers.reloadNote: Triggers are read when the plugin loads: adding, removing or reassigning one takes effect after a reload.

characters.name: Sequence
characters.desc: The characters to type, {{max}} at most (e.g., @@, //d)

mode.name: Opens
mode.desc: What this sequence opens. Any mode works with any length.

validation.tooLong: Trigger must be {{max}} characters or less
validation.minRequired: At least one trigger is required

presets.description: List of all format presets available for use in commands and settings. The toggle on a row only decides whether that format appears in the inline suggestion popup.
presets.showInSuggest: Show in the inline suggestion popup

errors.dailyNoteMissing: Daily note does not exist: {{date}}. Enable "Auto-create" in settings to create automatically.

notices.settingsMigrated: Date Helpers: Settings updated to Phase 6. Please reload the plugin (Cmd/Ctrl+R) to see updated commands.
